properties.message_511: On I-81 at mile marker 51 in the County of Smyth, motorists can expect delays due to a tractor trailer crash. The south exit ramp narrows.
On I-95 at mile marker 151.5 in the County of Prince William, motorists can expect delays due to a disabled vehicle. The south right shoulder is closed.
On I-64 at mile marker 275.6 in the City of Norfolk, near Bay Avenue, motorists can expect delays due to a tractor trailer crash. The east right shoulder is closed.
